title: DropKV: Decoupling Residual-Output Perturbation for Near-Optimal KV-Cache Eviction
abstract: arXiv:2610.22130v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Key-value (KV) cache management has become a critical bottleneck for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) to long-context scenarios due to linear memory growth. While recent eviction methods have moved beyond simple attention-score heuristics to incorporate value representations, they typically face a fundamental trade-off: the underlying optimization for minimizing output perturbation is an NP-hard combinatorial problem, leading to mathematically suboptimal heuristics or implementations that are difficult to kernelize. translated_title: DropKV：通过解耦残差输出扰动实现近似最优的KV缓存淘汰
translated_abstract: 键值（KV）缓存管理由于内存随上下文长度线性增长，已成为将大语言模型（LLM）扩展到长上下文场景的关键瓶颈。尽管近期的缓存淘汰方法已经超越了简单的注意力分数启发式策略，开始引入值表示信息，但它们通常面临一个根本性的权衡：最小化输出扰动的底层优化本质上是一个NP难的组合问题，这导致现有方法要么在数学上次优，要么难以进行内核化实现。在本工作中，我们提出了DropKV，一个基于解耦残差输出扰动（Decoupled Residual-Output Perturbation）的简单而有原则的缓存淘汰框架。通过将联合淘汰决策解耦为独立的逐token打分，DropKV规避了组合优化的难解性，并在一个锥条件（cone condition）下获得了可证明的常数因子近似保证，该条件在三个长上下文LLM上得到了实证验证。为确保实际可用性，我们（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: DropKV通过将KV缓存淘汰决策解耦为独立的逐token打分，规避了NP难的组合优化问题，并在锥条件下提供了可证明的常数因子近似保证，从而实现近似最优的KV缓存淘汰。
en_tdlr: DropKV decouples the joint KV-cache eviction decision into independent per-token scoring, circumventing NP-hard combinatorial optimization and providing a provable constant-factor approximation guarantee for near-optimal cache eviction.
